_doctrine: ALPHA/BETA two-account structure (runbook 2026-08-21b, re-corrected 2026-08-21c). ALPHA = the marketable hedge fund: every COURT-PICKED name (incl. the 31-name TLH core), envelopes, options templates — selection by judgment, gated by courts. BETA = the $5M deployment: DIRECT-INDEX REPLICATION in single names selected MECHANICALLY (no courts because no thesis claim — courts gate judgment, replication is a rule) + XND hedge + SGOV reserve. The dividing line is NOT single-name vs fund — it is judgment vs rule. A courted name may never enter BETA; a replication name may never be sized by view. PARAMETRIC COLLISION RULE: BETA replicates the COMPLETION set — broad market MINUS Parametric's current holdings (weekly bundle refresh) — so household direct-indexing never washes against itself by construction. Cash-only crossings between accounts. Wash perimeter household-wide regardless.
